sentences.en: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her cookery book.
sentences.zh: 齐里问莉玛是否可以借用她的烹饪书。

sentences.en: My mum follows this cookery book closely whenever she cooks something.
sentences.zh: 妈妈每次做饭时都会仔细跟着这本烹饪书来做。

sentences.en: Recipes for chafing dish cookery abound.
sentences.zh: 涮锅类菜肴的食谱非常丰富。
